title.zh: 分子氢弹性碰撞频率聚合

summary: Reduce two supplied Alpha fields and one branch-time H2-H2 SIG contraction to molecular elastic Omega channels, bulk flow and perpendicular moment on the caller's cylindrical velocity grid. The H2-H denominator remains inside the weighted sum.

identity.relation: molecular H2 elastic Omega_H2_P, Omega_H2_H and Omega_H2_H2 frequency aggregation
identity.direction: branch-time H2 distribution and density, supplied Alpha fields, H2-H2 SIG matrix and explicit velocity quadrature -> six spatial profiles
identity.definition: VxH2[k]=Vth*sum(Vr2pidVr*(fH2[:,:,k]@(vx*dVx)))/nH2[k]. H2-P and H2-H reduce Alpha*fH2 over the velocity carrier using sign(DeltaVx)*max(abs(DeltaVx),DeltaVx_tol), with vxi and VxH as targets; H2-P divides outside np.sum while H2-H divides each radial summand inside np.sum. H2-H2 selects the direct vr^2-2*(vx-VxH2/Vth)^2 moment when sum(MH2_H2_sum)<0, otherwise the negative vr2_2vx2_2D*(MH2_H2_sum-fH2) moment. The branch-time fH2 is flattened and restored in Fortran order around SIG_H2_H2, then the weighted reduction is divided by nH2[k]*sign(Wperp_paraH2)*max(abs(Wperp_paraH2),Wpp_tol). All channels are clamped at zero and Omega_EL is their exact sum.
identity.model: saved KN1DPy molecular elastic-frequency reduction; supplied Alpha and SIG carriers are explicit dependencies
identity.geometry: cylindrical (vr,vx) velocity carrier per spatial cell x, with N=nvr*nvx Fortran-order matrix indexing
identity.coordinates: vr and vx are normalized by Vth; Vth, vxi and VxH share physical velocity units; no implicit conversion
identity.boundary: finite nonempty aligned arrays; positive finite scalar Vth and tolerance floors; nH2 must be positive when any elastic channel is enabled; exact zero velocity difference or perpendicular moment in an enabled channel raises ValueError despite a positive floor
assumptions: Each Alpha field comes from the corresponding molecular Alpha contraction and SIG_H2_H2 from molecular collision-matrix assembly; this callable consumes the explicit arrays rather than invoking those functions.
The global sum(MH2_H2_sum) selects one moment formula for all x cells; molecular equality at zero selects the accumulated-moment branch.
The enabled channel flags use Python truthiness, as in the saved implementation; with all channels disabled, finite zero density is accepted and all outputs are zero.

inputs.name: fH2
inputs.description: Molecular H2 distribution at branch time.

inputs.name: nH2
inputs.description: Molecular H2 density by spatial cell.
inputs.constraints: Finite; strictly positive when any channel is enabled.

inputs.name: Alpha_H2_P
inputs.constraints: Finite and exactly aligned with fH2; signed cells are retained.

inputs.name: Alpha_H2_H
inputs.constraints: Finite and exactly aligned with fH2; signed cells are retained.

inputs.name: SIG_H2_H2
inputs.constraints: Finite and square with order N; Fortran carrier layout.

inputs.name: Vr2pidVr
inputs.constraints: Finite one-dimensional array aligned with vr.

inputs.name: dVx
inputs.constraints: Finite one-dimensional array aligned with vx.

inputs.name: MH2_H2_sum
inputs.description: Accumulated H2-H2 elastic moment at branch time.
inputs.constraints: Finite and aligned with fH2; total sum selects the moment branch.

inputs.name: vr2_2vx2_2D
inputs.constraints: Finite and aligned with velocity axes; used in the nonnegative-accumulator branch.

inputs.name: DeltaVx_tol
inputs.description: Magnitude floor for normalized velocity difference.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; zero sign still fails.

inputs.name: Wpp_tol
inputs.description: Magnitude floor for perpendicular moment denominator.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; zero sign still fails.

outputs.name: VxH2
outputs.constraints: Finite; zero with all channels off.

outputs.name: Omega_H2_P
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; zero when disabled.

outputs.name: Omega_H2_H
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; zero when disabled.

outputs.name: Omega_H2_H2
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; zero when disabled.

outputs.name: Omega_EL
outputs.description: Sum of the three elastic channels.
outputs.constraints: Exact floating-point sum of the clamped channels.

outputs.name: Wperp_paraH2
outputs.description: Selected perpendicular moment before the Wpp floor.
outputs.constraints: Finite; may be signed or zero; zero when H2-H2 is disabled.

preconditions: The caller supplies mutually aligned source-normalized velocity carriers and branch-time fields.
Enabled channels have positive density and nonzero signed denominators.
supported: Stateless molecular H2 elastic Omega aggregation on finite cylindrical velocity carriers.
excluded: State iteration, source cache lifecycle, matrix construction, cross-model transport closure and external physical validation.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for malformed or non-finite carrier arrays, invalid SIG order, or nonpositive Vth/floors; enabled channels reject nonpositive density and zero signed DeltaVx or Wpp.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if any assembled output is non-finite; no mapping is returned.

python.signature: assemble_molecular_hydrogen_omega_frequencies(fH2, nH2, Alpha_H2_P, Alpha_H2_H, SIG_H2_H2, Vr2pidVr, dVx, vr, vx, Vth, vxi, VxH, MH2_H2_sum, vr2_2vx2_2D, DeltaVx_tol=0.01, Wpp_tol=0.001, H2_P_EL=True, H2_H_EL=True, H2_H2_EL=True)

example.description: Reduce a one-cell H2 distribution over a two-by-two velocity mesh.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.collisions import assemble_molecular_hydrogen_omega_frequencies
f = np.ones((2, 2, 1))
r = assemble_molecular_hydrogen_omega_frequencies(f, np.array([10.]), np.ones_like(f), np.ones_like(f), -np.eye(4), np.array([1., 2.]), np.ones(2), np.array([0.5, 1.]), np.array([-1., 2.]), 1000., np.array([0.]), np.array([100.]), np.zeros_like(f), np.array([[0.25-2., 0.25-8.], [1.-2., 1.-8.]]))
assert set(r) == {'VxH2', 'Omega_H2_P', 'Omega_H2_H', 'Omega_H2_H2', 'Omega_EL', 'Wperp_paraH2'}
assert all(np.isfinite(value).all() for value in r.values())
assert np.array_equal(r['Omega_EL'], r['Omega_H2_P'] + r['Omega_H2_H'] + r['Omega_H2_H2'])
example.expected: Six finite one-cell profiles, including the exact sum of three nonnegative Omega channels.

scope: Independent quadrature oracles check all six outputs, sign branches, clamps, Fortran carrier and enabled-channel gating.
SHA-gated saved replay compares both moment branches and the zero boundary exactly on finite manufactured inputs; singular witnesses document maintained failures.
verification.evidence_ceiling: The tested carrier and branches support bounded agreement with saved reductions, not physical collision-frequency accuracy, matrix conservation, a qualified D1 source freeze or expert approval.
known_limitations: Saved source's zero-sign floor creates a non-finite quotient; this implementation raises ValueError.
The source's H2-H denominator placement and zero-accumulator moment branch are retained; their physical interpretation requires expert review.
